kind: compiled non-crypto ABI shim binding probe; source unchanged
argv:
set -e
ar=/inputs/toolchain/usr/bin/i686-w64-mingw32-ar
objcopy=/inputs/toolchain/usr/bin/i686-w64-mingw32-objcopy
nm=/inputs/toolchain/usr/bin/i686-w64-mingw32-nm
cp /inputs/monero-fcmp/build/portable/src/fcmp_pp/fcmp_pp_rust/libfcmp_pp_rust.a /probe/rust-original.a
member=$($ar t /probe/rust-original.a | grep '^fcmp_pp_rust-[0-9a-f]*\.fcmp_pp_rust\.[0-9a-f]*-cgu\.0\.rcgu\.o$')
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$member" | wc -l)" -eq 1
printf '%s\n' "$member" > /probe/shim-member.txt
mkdir /probe/original /probe/weak
$ar p /probe/rust-original.a "$member" > /probe/original/"$member"
python3 - <<'ENDPY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct
member=Path('/probe/shim-member.txt').read_text().strip()
b=bytearray((Path('/probe/original')/member).read_bytes()); original=bytes(b)
machine,nsec,stamp,symoff,nsym,opt,flags=struct.unpack_from('<HHIIIHH',b)
assert machine==0x14c and opt==0
strtab=symoff+nsym*18
found=[]; i=0
while i<nsym:
 raw,val,sec,typ,storage,aux=struct.unpack_from('<8sIhHBB',b,symoff+18*i)
 name=(bytes(b[strtab+struct.unpack_from('<I',raw,4)[0]:]).split(b'\0',1)[0] if raw[:4]==b'\0'*4 else raw.split(b'\0',1)[0])
 if name==b'__Unwind_Resume':
  assert val==0 and sec==1 and typ==32 and storage==2 and aux==0
  found.append(symoff+18*i+16)
 i+=1+aux
assert len(found)==1
b[found[0]]=105
assert [i for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(original,b)) if x!=y]==found
(Path('/probe/weak')/member).write_bytes(b)
ENDPY
cp /probe/rust-original.a /probe/rust-weak.a
$ar rcs /probe/rust-weak.a /probe/weak/"$member"
$nm --defined-only /probe/original/"$member" > /probe/original-symbols.txt
$nm --defined-only /probe/weak/"$member" > /probe/weak-symbols.txt
set +e
/inputs/toolchain/usr/bin/i686-w64-mingw32-g++-posix -std=c++17 -O0 -static -I/inputs/monero-fcmp/src/fcmp_pp/fcmp_pp_rust /probe/probe.cpp /probe/rust-original.a -lws2_32 -luserenv -lntdll -lbcrypt -ladvapi32 -lsynchronization -o /probe/original.exe > /probe/original-link.txt 2>&1
original=$?
set -e
test "$original" -ne 0
grep 'multiple definition.*_Unwind_Resume' /probe/original-link.txt
/inputs/toolchain/usr/bin/i686-w64-mingw32-g++-posix -std=c++17 -O0 -static -I/inputs/monero-fcmp/src/fcmp_pp/fcmp_pp_rust /probe/probe.cpp /probe/rust-weak.a -lws2_32 -luserenv -lntdll -lbcrypt -ladvapi32 -lsynchronization -Wl,-Map,/probe/weak-link.map -o /probe/weak.exe
$nm --defined-only /probe/weak.exe > /probe/final-symbols.txt
/inputs/toolchain/usr/bin/i686-w64-mingw32-objdump -p /probe/weak.exe > /probe/weak-pe.txt
